7337.title: Reconnect retries storage deletion after cleanup has completed
7337.rootCauseOneLine: Reconnect reconciliation ignores storageDeletedAt and repeats host cleanup for retained deleted rows.
7337.proposedFix: Finalize deleted threads whose storage is already removed; retry host deletion only for unfinished cleanup.
7337.caveats: Two trusted clean-checkout server tests reproduce redundant RPCs. macOS lsof counts and outage timing were not measured. Full regression source and evidence are inline under the reports repository artifact policy.
